summary: Tapping Like swaps the outline thumb for a filled thumb with a pop: the outline collapses to ~30% in 50 ms, the filled thumb springs up to 1.20x while tilting back ~12 deg, and a ring of 10 red/pink rays bursts outward and decays to dots (~420 ms). On a comedy video the watch-page Like instead plays a themed variant: the thumb morphs into a laughing-face emoji orbited by red dots for ~0.5 s before the filled thumb pops in. Unlike, Dislike and Un-dislike have no icon animation (instant glyph swap) and only show the press highlight / ripple.
trigger: Single tap on the Like button (watch-page action row or feed video card). Animation starts on touch-up, not touch-down.

interactions.label: Tap Like - watch page (comedy video) -> laughing-emoji themed like animation
Tap Like again - unlike (instant swap, press highlight only)
Tap Dislike - watch page (instant swap to filled)
Tap Like - feed video card (standard thumb pop + ray burst, count '15K' unchanged)
Tap Like again on feed card - unlike (instant swap)
Tap Dislike on feed card - circular ripple, instant swap
Tap Dislike again on feed card - un-dislike, ripple
Tap Like - second watch page (standard thumb pop + ray burst) [representative]
Tap Like again - unlike (instant swap; time +/-33 ms, from 15 fps sheet)

elements.name: Like icon (outline)
elements.notes: Measured glyph bbox 59x62 px; sits in a ~24 pt icon box. ~2 pt stroke. Watch-page center (245.5, 394.8) pt on 2nd video, (245.3, 454) pt on 1st; feed card center (27.3, 553.7) pt.

elements.name: Like icon (filled)
elements.notes: Filled glyph bbox 57x59 px. Final rest state of a liked button.

elements.name: Ray burst
elements.notes: 10 rays at 36 deg spacing, alternating 5 long red (#FF0033, ~3 pt wide, ~7 pt long) and 5 short pink (#FF2893, ~2.5 pt wide, ~4.5 pt long). Long rays at approx 22, 90, 158, 232, 309 deg; short at 55, 123, 194, 271, 346 deg (0 deg = right, CCW). Centered on icon. Max outer radius ~21 pt (64 px).

elements.name: Press highlight (watch page)
elements.notes: Vertical capsule 123x146 px centered on the icon, appears instantly on touch-down. On touch-up the fill fades and a 1 pt ring #474747 appears and fades.

elements.name: Press highlight (feed card)
elements.notes: On touch-down the entire card action bar background goes #0F0F0F -> #272727 plus a 40 pt circle (slightly lighter, ~#2D2D2D) around the like icon; fades after release.

elements.name: Dislike ripple (feed card)
elements.notes: Material-style touch ripple: circle grows from the touch point to a 40 pt circle centered on the dislike icon, then fades.

elements.name: Laughing emoji (themed variant)
elements.notes: White laughing face (squinting >< eyes, open D mouth) with black features; 69 px at full size. Orbited by 2-4 red #FF0033 dots, 3-4 pt diameter, at 12-20 pt radius.

elements.name: Like count
elements.notes: Feed card shows '15K' next to the thumb; it did not change (rounded). Watch page 1 shows '28K likes' in metadata, unchanged. No count animation observed.

animations.name: Press highlight on touch-down, ring fade on touch-up (watch page)
animations.easing: Fill: instant on at touch-down, ~linear-to-ease-out fade ~280 ms from touch-up. Ring: appears at touch-up (~34 ms after touch-down on a quick tap), fades roughly linearly over ~330 ms.

animations.name: Outline thumb collapses
animations.notes: Starts ~33 ms after touch-up. At ~0.3 scale the glyph is swapped to the filled thumb (frame at +50 ms is already filled). Feed card: collapse 8.107-8.140 (same).

animations.name: Filled thumb pop (overshoot, hold, settle) with tilt

properties.prop: rotate (CCW +, i.e. thumb tips back toward the left)
properties.notes: overshoots to -6 deg (clockwise) after settle, then 0

animations.easing: Keyframed (Lottie-like), not a single spring: grow 0.32->1.20 in ~167 ms ease-out; hold 1.20 for ~200 ms; return 1.20->1.0 in ~167 ms ease-in-out; rotation swings +12 -> -6 -> 0 over the last ~270 ms.
animations.notes: Rotation samples (CCW +, deg; t from 15.945; fitted in 3 deg steps): [[0, 0], [33, -9], [50, -9], [67, -12], [100, -3], [117, 3], [133, 6], [167, 9], [200, 12], [417, 12], [433, 9], [500, 6], [533, 6], [550, 0], [567, -3], [583, -6], [717, -6], [733, -3], [800, -3], [817, 0]]. Fitting IoU ~0.84 at peak, so the glyph may also deform slightly. Feed card repeat (8.140-8.905) matched within one frame: peak 1.20 at +198 ms from blob, hold to +382 ms, 1.0 at +548 ms. Frame duplicates at 16.012/16.028 and 16.078/16.095 are recorder drops.

animations.name: Radial ray burst

properties.notes: tail catches up with the head -> ray shrinks into a dot
full until ~300 ms, fades last ~100 ms while shrinking

animations.easing: Head: strong ease-out, reaches max radius in ~130 ms then stops. Tail: ease-out over ~300 ms. Classic trim-path burst.

samples.prop: long-ray outer radius (pt) from icon center; t from 8.223 (feed card burst start)

animations.notes: Starts when the filled thumb passes ~1.06x (first visible frame already at 8-9 pt inner radius, so it may start 1 frame earlier inside the glyph). Inner-radius samples (pt): [[0, 8.3], [65, 12.0], [132, 14.0], [215, 17.0], [299, 17.7], [365, 18.3]]. Long and short rays start together (no stagger); short rays start ~2 pt further out. Burst is identical on the feed card (8.223-8.638) and 2nd watch page (16.078-16.495).

animations.name: Themed like: thumb -> laughing emoji -> filled thumb (watch page, comedy video)

properties.notes: 1.315-1.698 (~385 ms), drifts ~1.7 pt left; 2-4 red dots orbit 1.265-1.815

animations.easing: Emoji in: ease-out (~cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.3,1)). Emoji out: ease-in. Final thumb: quick overshoot ~12%, no ray burst.

animations.name: Feed card action-bar highlight
animations.easing: Instant on at touch-down; fades ~250 ms ease-out after touch-up (~8.09).

samples.prop: bar bg luminance, t from touch-down 9.155 (unlike tap, clean bg)

animations.notes: Same highlight appears for like and unlike on the card. A 40 pt circle ring around the like icon is visible during the fade.

samples.prop: ripple diameter (pt) once larger than the icon, t from 9.753

animations.notes: Glyph swaps outline->filled instantly at 9.753 (no scale). Un-dislike at 10.487 is the same ripple (expansion 10.487-10.653, fade to 10.72) with instant swap back to outline.

animations.name: Dislike / un-dislike / unlike on watch page

properties.notes: instant swap at 3.445 (~33 ms after touch-up), no scale/rotation

keyframe_images.caption: Standard like: rest -> collapse (+117 ms) -> 1.2x peak with ray burst -> ray tails -> liked rest
Peak: filled thumb at 1.20x tilted back ~12 deg, 10 alternating red/pink rays
Themed like (comedy video): pressed capsule -> emoji in -> emoji with orbiting red dots -> emoji out -> thumb 1.12x -> rest
Feed card: card-wide press highlight, like burst, dislike ripple, disliked rest

observations: Like animation fires on touch-up: ~33 ms after release the outline collapses; touch-down only shows the press highlight.

The like animation varies by context: on a comedy podcast watch page the thumb morphs into a laughing-face emoji with orbiting red dots (~0.95 s total, no ray burst). On the feed card and on another watch page it is the standard pop + 10-ray burst (~0.82 s from collapse to settled rotation). Probably YouTube's content-themed like animations; that cause is a guess.
Burst colors are YouTube red #FF0033 (long rays) and pink #FF2893 (short rays). Everything else is monochrome white on #000000 (watch) or #0F0F0F (feed).
Unlike, dislike and un-dislike use an instant glyph swap. Only the press feedback animates (capsule + fading 1 pt ring on the watch page; card-wide highlight or 40 pt ripple on the feed card).
Counts ('15K', '28K likes') did not change, because they are rounded. No number roll animation.
The thumb's rotation pivot looks like roughly the glyph center (centroid moves under 2 pt).
open_questions: Whether the laughing-emoji variant is driven by video category or some other signal can't be told from the recording.
The filled thumb's shape may deform a little during the pop (template fit IoU ~0.84 at peak). Scale/rotation is an approximation of a Lottie animation.
Some frames are duplicated by the recorder (e.g. 16.012/16.028, 1.198/1.215), so per-frame timings are +/-17 ms.
Haptics can't be observed. On iOS, YouTube likely fires a light impact on like.
Watch-page capsule measured 41x48.7 pt. It may be a 41 pt circle stretched by the row height. Check against the YouTube iOS layout if precision matters.
